objs.name: document
objs.description: A managed information object (policy, guideline, procedural instruction, work instruction) that goes through creation, editing, release, distribution, versioning and archiving lifecycle.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Classification of the document (e.g. policy, guideline, procedural instruction, work instruction).

attributes.name: document_abbreviation
attributes.description: Type abbreviation and consecutive number identifying the document (e.g. RL_0001).

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the document (e.g. editing, released, out of force, archived).

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version number of the document, incremented on each revision cycle.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which the released version of the document is valid.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date until which the document remains valid, calculated from Valid From plus validity period.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Scope or area of validity of the document.

attributes.name: language
attributes.description: Original language of the document content.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Period for which an invalidated document is retained before physical deletion (default 10 years).

attributes.name: validity_period
attributes.description: Period after which validity must be re-checked (default 3 years).

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: A controlled sub-document linked to a main document that is subject to its own versioning and is released together with the main document.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the attachment.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version number of the attachment.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: A supplementary document added to a main document that is not subject to the release cycle and can be published directly via property switches.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Published or unpublished status of the additional information.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: A proposal for changing an existing released document, managed in the document cockpit and tracked to completion.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Status of the change proposal (e.g. created, scheduled, completed).

objs.name: request_for_validity_extension
objs.description: A system-generated request created 30 days before document validity expires, requiring workflow-supported processing.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current processing status of the validity extension request.

objs.name: request_for_override
objs.description: A request to invalidate a document and archive it, triggering the out-of-force process.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current processing status of the override request.

objs.name: request_for_reactivation
objs.description: A request to reactivate a previously invalidated and archived document, restricted to the Business Admin group.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current processing status of the reactivation request.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: A group of users defined in the system for assigning read or change authorizations on documents.

attributes.name: group_name
attributes.description: Name of the user group (e.g. Reader - Document Management, Authors, Reviewer, Releaser, Archive).

objs.name: person
objs.description: An individual user in the system who can hold roles such as author, co-author, reviewer, releaser or translator.

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: System role assigned to the person (e.g. Author, Co-Author, Reviewer, Releaser, Translator, Reader).

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: A list of user groups and persons assigned to a document for email notification or acknowledgement upon release.

attributes.name: distribution_type
attributes.description: Type of distribution: by email or for acknowledgement.

objs.name: workflow
objs.description: A workflow instance supporting the approval, validity extension, override, reactivation or acknowledgement process.

attributes.name: workflow_type
attributes.description: Type of workflow (e.g. release, validity extension, override, reactivation, acknowledgement, translation release).

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status of the workflow instance.

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: A signature applied by a workflow participant to confirm completion of a workflow step, documented per released version.

attributes.name: signer
attributes.description: Person who applied the signature.

attributes.name: step
attributes.description: Workflow step at which the signature was applied (e.g. Creator, Review, Release).

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: A predefined template associated with a document type, selectable when creating new documents.

attributes.name: template_name
attributes.description: Name of the document template.

attributes.name: source_format
attributes.description: Office format of the template (e.g. Word, Excel, PowerPoint).

objs.name: document_type
objs.description: A classification category for documents defining level, abbreviation, validity period and archive duration.

attributes.name: level
attributes.description: Hierarchical level in the document pyramid (e.g. Level 2 for guidelines, Level 4 for work instructions).

attributes.name: type_abbreviation
attributes.description: Language-independent abbreviation for the document type.

attributes.name: default_validity_period
attributes.description: Default period for validity extension checks.

attributes.name: default_archive_duration
attributes.description: Default period for archiving before physical deletion.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: A new document (information object) is created in DHC VISION by selecting a document type and optionally a template.

attributes.name: document_type_selected
attributes.description: The document type chosen during creation.

attributes.name: template_selected
attributes.description: The template chosen during creation, if any.

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: The content of a document is edited using the integrated editing client in the corresponding Office application.

evts.name: edit_document_properties
evts.description: Metadata and attributes of a document are maintained or modified in the properties dialog.

evts.name: convert_to_pdf
evts.description: The document is automatically converted to PDF format after saving.

evts.name: start_release_workflow
evts.description: The 3-step release workflow (Creator - Review - Release) is initiated by the author or a co-author.

evts.name: sign_creator_step
evts.description: The registered author signs the Creator step of the release workflow with an electronic signature.

evts.name: sign_review_step
evts.description: A reviewer completes the review step with an electronic signature, confirming technical or formal check.

attributes.name: review_result
attributes.description: Positive or rejection outcome of the review.

evts.name: sign_release_step
evts.description: A releaser completes the release step with an electronic signature, approving or rejecting the document.

attributes.name: release_result
attributes.description: Positive or rejection outcome of the release.

evts.name: reject_during_review
evts.description: A reviewer rejects the document during the review step, causing the workflow to be canceled for subsequent participants.

evts.name: reject_during_release
evts.description: A releaser rejects the document during the release step, causing the workflow to be canceled for subsequent participants.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: The document is released and automatically published, becoming visible to addressed readers.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: The released document is made visible to readers after release.

evts.name: create_new_version
evts.description: A new editing version of a released document is created for revision, retaining data from the previous version.

evts.name: create_attachment
evts.description: An attachment (controlled document) is added to a main document.

evts.name: modify_attachment
evts.description: An existing attachment is modified, triggering a new version of the main document.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: An attachment is marked for archiving and archived upon release of the next main document version.

evts.name: create_additional_info
evts.description: An additional info object is added to a document without affecting the release cycle.

evts.name: modify_additional_info
evts.description: An additional info object is modified without affecting the main document version.

evts.name: delete_additional_info
evts.description: An additional info object is deleted without affecting the main document version.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: A change proposal is created for an existing released document by an author without affecting the document content or version.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal
evts.description: A change proposal is scheduled for implementation, creating a new version of the document.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: A change proposal is documented as completed by the author, triggering an email notification to the proposal creator.

evts.name: create_validity_extension_request
evts.description: The system automatically creates a request for validity extension 30 days before the validity expires.

evts.name: process_validity_extension
evts.description: The validity extension request is processed through the workflow by releaser (or author, reviewer and releaser).

attributes.name: outcome
attributes.description: Result of the validity check: extend validity, revise, or invalidate.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: The validity of the document is extended, updating the Valid Until date by the default period.

evts.name: create_override_request
evts.description: A request for override (invalidation) is created for a document by a user with write access.

evts.name: process_override
evts.description: The override request is processed through the workflow by releaser (or initiator, reviewer and releaser).

attributes.name: outcome
attributes.description: Result of the override process: confirmed or rejected.

evts.name: declare_out_of_force
evts.description: The document is declared out of force, its last valid version is archived, and all rights except archive group are revoked.

evts.name: create_reactivation_request
evts.description: A request for reactivation is created by the Business Admin group for a previously invalidated document.

evts.name: process_reactivation
evts.description: The reactivation workflow is processed by the initiator, resulting in a new version of the document.

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: An invalidated document is reactivated with a new version, restoring metadata, authorizations and distribution list.

evts.name: distribute_by_email
evts.description: Users on the distribution list are notified by email upon release of a new document version.

evts.name: distribute_for_acknowledgement
evts.description: Users on the distribution list are requested by email to confirm acknowledgement of the released document.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: A recipient confirms acknowledgement of the document through a workflow-supported task without signature.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Read or change authorizations are assigned to user groups or persons on a document.

evts.name: revoke_authorization
evts.description: Authorizations are revoked from user groups or persons, e.g. during archiving.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Released document content is translated into another language.

attributes.name: target_language
attributes.description: The language into which the document is translated.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: A translated language version is released after review and approval through a workflow.

evts.name: send_email_notification
evts.description: The system sends an email notification to inform users about workflow tasks, status changes or pending actions.

attributes.name: notification_type
attributes.description: Type of notification (e.g. workflow task, validity extension info, override info, acknowledgement request).

evts.name: physical_deletion
evts.description: A document is physically deleted from the system after the archive period has expired.
